orderReconcileStillShort: The shelf is still short; nothing shipped.

returnReason_approval_issued: An approval was granted; mark it unknown, then no effect with evidence.
returnReason_retry: Another return of the same goods changed; try again.
returnReason_not_covered: The order is not paid or approved on credit.
returnReason_return_entitlement_depends_: A return refund depends on this collection.
capabilityCashMoveHint: Record cash put in, taken out or dropped to the safe on your own shift, always with a reason. Not a sale or a customer payment.
capabilityReportReadHint: Read reports for every shift at the branch. Without it, staff see their own shifts only.
capabilityReportExportHint: Create CSV report files. Only the requester can download them; they are deleted after 24 hours.
shiftsHint: Cash in/out, drawer count and shift close. Expected drawer cash is shown only after you enter your count.
shiftNone: No open shift for this selection
shiftNoneHint: Pick your register or open a shift on the sale screen.
shiftStatusCounted: Open · drawer counted, waiting to close
shiftBlindNotice: Blind count: expected drawer cash is not shown until you enter your count.
shiftChecklistBlocked_one: {{count}} item must be resolved before closing.
shiftChecklistBlocked_other: {{count}} items must be resolved before closing.
shiftChecklistWarnings: Drafts without payment do not block the close; when you reopen one it continues on your new shift:
shiftBlindCountHint: Count all cash in the drawer and enter the total. Expected cash and the variance appear after it is recorded.
shiftCountStale: Cash moved after the last count; count again.
shiftExpectedExplained: Expected = opening float + cash kept (sales after change, debt collections, unsolicited cash, cash in) − cash paid out (refunds, excess payouts, cash out, safe drops). Bank transfers and debt are not counted.
shiftNeedsApproval: The variance needs a reason and another person's approval.
shiftNeedsApprovalThreshold: The variance exceeds {{threshold}}: a reason and another person's approval are needed.
shiftWaitingApproval: Waiting for a manager's approval. Reason: {{reason}}
shiftClosedImmutable: Closed figures cannot change. Cash found later is reconciled separately without rewriting this shift.
shiftAmountInvalid: Enter a whole amount above zero.
shiftReason_shift_closed: The shift is closed; no more cash can be recorded on it.
shiftReason_close_blocked: Some items must be resolved before closing.
shiftReason_count_stale: Cash moved after the count; count again.
shiftReason_recount_required: Only the person who counted can close; count again.
shiftReason_revision_stale: The count just changed; review it before approving.
shiftReason_self_approval: You cannot approve your own count or reconciliation.
shiftReason_insufficient_cash: The drawer does not hold that much cash.
shiftReason_evidence_required: Safe and handover custody need a reference.
shiftReason_outcome_invalid: Choose where the money is now.
shiftReason_source_required: Choose a closed shift or held cash.
shiftReason_target_required: Choose the open drawer receiving the cash.
shiftReason_target_invalid: Only cash put into a drawer or an opening float names a shift.
shiftReason_not_held: Only cash held outside the drawer is reconciled here.
shiftReason_shift_mismatch: The held cash was recorded on a different shift.
shiftReason_amount_mismatch: The amount must equal the held cash.
shiftReason_no_overage: Only a shift that was over can be explained by late cash.
shiftReason_exceeds_variance: The amount exceeds that shift's unexplained overage.
shiftApprovalsList: Shifts waiting for a variance approval
shiftApprovalsEmpty: No shift is waiting for a variance approval.
cashMovementInHint: Cash added to the drawer (e.g. change float). Not a sale.
cashMovementOutHint: Cash taken out needs a reference and another person's confirmation; the drawer only changes once confirmed.
lateCashHint: For cash found after a shift closed. Pick the shift that was over and/or the held cash, then say where the money is now. Closed shifts never change; only cash put into an open drawer now raises that drawer.
lateCashEmpty: No overage or held cash to reconcile.
lateCashRecordedByMe: recorded by you; someone else must reconcile
lateCashStepCustody: Step 2: where the money is now
lateCashOutcome_in_opening_float: Already in a later opening float
lateCashOutcome_new_physical_inflow: Put into an open drawer now
lateCashOutcomeHint_in_opening_float: The cash was counted into the next shift's opening float; that drawer does not grow again.
lateCashOutcomeHint_safe: The cash is in the safe; a bag or slip number is required.
lateCashOutcomeHint_handed_over: The cash was handed to someone; a handover reference is required.
lateCashOutcomeHint_new_physical_inflow: The cash is actually put into an open drawer; that drawer grows by exactly this amount once.
lateCashAddsDrawer: This adds the cash to the chosen drawer.
lateCashNoDrawer: This does not add cash to the current drawer.
lateCashTargetFloat: Shift whose opening float holds it (optional)
lateCashDoneInflow: Reconciled {{amount}} and added it to the open drawer.
lateCashDoneCustody: Reconciled {{amount}}; nothing was added to a current drawer.
reportsHint: Sales, receipts, drawer cash, receivables and shift closes are computed separately on the server, in the branch timezone.
reportTabHint_sales: Orders by sale time; returns separately by the day goods came back. Sales are not money received.
reportTabHint_receipts: Money actually received by arrival time; booking time is shown separately. Collections and unsolicited receipts are apart from sales.
reportTabHint_cashbook: Every drawer cash movement per shift with the expected cash after it. Overnight shifts appear on both days.
reportTabHint_receivables: Current balances from the receivable ledger (after returns and collections).
reportTabHint_closures: Figures fixed at close and overage reconciled afterwards.
reportRangeInvalid: Invalid date range (at most 366 days, start not after end).
reportExportQueued: Export requested; the file will appear in the list below.
reportExportsHint: Only you can download them while you may still export. Files are deleted after 24 hours.
adminVarianceThresholdHint: A drawer variance above this needs a reason and another person's approval. Blank: every variance needs one.
adminVarianceThresholdInvalid: The variance threshold must be a whole amount, or blank.
cashMovementRequested: Requested {{kind}} {{amount}}; waiting for someone else to confirm.
shiftCommandChecking: Checking the result: it is not known yet whether the last command was recorded.
shiftCountRecovered: An earlier count was already recorded: {{amount}}. Count again if it is wrong.
shiftFailureGeneric: That did not work. Reload and try again.
cashRequestsEmpty: No drawer outflow is waiting for confirmation.
cashRequestsHint: Cash out and safe drops are only recorded once someone else confirms the cash and the reference.
cashRequestOwn: Your request; someone else confirms it.
shiftOthersHint: Close for an absent cashier: you count the drawer; a variance still needs another approver.
lateCashHeldClosure: That shift closed with counted {{counted}}, expected {{expected}}; this cash counts against its overage.
lateCashOverageExplained: That shift's overage is already reconciled; this held cash cannot explain more.
reportExportExpired: The export expired; create it again
shiftReason_overage_explained: That shift's overage is already reconciled; this cash is not counted twice.
shiftReason_exceeds_float: The amount exceeds what remains of the chosen shift's opening float.
shiftReason_held_custody: This cash is held outside the drawer; pay it from custody with a reference.
shiftReason_not_awaiting: This request is no longer waiting.
shiftReason_retry: The data just changed; try again.
capabilityInventoryManageHint: Receive, transfer, count and adjust, declare opening balances, quarantine and release lots and serials at the branch.
capabilityInventoryTraceHint: Look up which orders and customers bought a lot or serial (recall). Customer phones stay masked.
adminLotSelectionHint: FEFO: the system takes the earliest-expiring lot in stock. Cashier pick: the cashier may name a lot; blank still uses FEFO.
adminAdjustmentThreshold: Positive adjustment without approval up to (base units)
adminAdjustmentThresholdHint: Blank: every positive adjustment needs approval. Negative adjustments always need approval.
adminAdjustmentThresholdInvalid: The adjustment threshold must be a whole number of zero or more, or blank.
inventoryHint: Serial and lot stock at the branch: on hand, expiry, receipts, transfers, counts and recall.
inventoryForbidden: You need the manage traced stock or trace lots and serials permission at this branch.
inventoryVariantsHint: Items sell only after their opening balance is declared and lot/serial stock matches the stock count.
inventoryOpeningHint: The serials or lot quantities must add up to the current stock ({{core}}).
inventorySerialListHint: Scan or type each serial and press Enter · {{count}} codes
inventoryLotCodeInvalid: Each lot needs a lot code (up to 64 characters).
inventoryQuantityInvalid: Quantity must be a whole positive number of base units.
inventoryQuantityTooMany: The quantity is more than the lot has available.
inventoryExpiryInvalid: The expiry date is not valid.
inventoryLotDuplicate: A lot code was entered twice.
inventoryNothingEntered: No serial or lot entered yet.
inventoryReceiveHint: Receive new serials or lots into the branch stock. An existing lot must keep its expiry.
inventoryTransferHint: Move serials or part of a lot to another branch. You need stock management at both branches.
inventoryNoDestination: There is no other branch to transfer to.
inventoryAdjustHint: Enter the counted quantity per lot, or missing and found serials. Adjustments over the branch threshold need another person to approve.
inventoryRecallHint: Search by lot code or serial: stock still holding it and the orders that sold it, with customers.
paymentTraceBlocked: Payment is blocked: lot/serial stock is not ready.
saleLineSerialHint: Scan or type one serial per line · {{count}} serials = {{count}} units
saleLineSerialLocked: Each unit is one serial; remove the line and scan again to change the quantity.
saleLineLotFefo: The lot is picked automatically, earliest expiry first (FEFO).
returnLotRequired: This line sold from several lots; choose the lot coming back.
traceReason_trace_unreconciled: The lot/serial stock of this item does not match the stock count; count it before selling.
traceReason_trace_not_enrolled: The item has no declared lot/serial opening balance.
traceReason_trace_serial_required: Serial item: scan or enter a serial for each unit.
traceReason_trace_serial_unavailable: The serial cannot be sold: already sold, at another branch, held by another counter, or unknown.
traceReason_trace_serial_released: The serial hold on this order expired; reserve it again.
traceReason_trace_lot_pick_forbidden: This branch picks lots automatically (FEFO); a lot cannot be chosen.
traceReason_trace_lot_invalid: The lot is not valid: unknown, expired, quarantined or out of stock.
traceReason_trace_stock_exists: Lot/serial stock exists; the conversion or tracking cannot change.
traceReason_trace_serial_mismatch: This serial was not sold on the chosen line.
traceReason_trace_lot_mismatch: This lot was not sold on the chosen line.
traceReason_trace_already_returned: This serial or lot was already returned.
traceReason_trace_return_detail_required: Choose the serials or lot coming back for this line.
traceReason_opening_unreconciled: The opening balance does not match the stock count.
traceReason_already_enrolled: The item already has an opening balance.
traceReason_not_tracked: The item is not tracked by lot or serial.
traceReason_lot_expired: The lot has expired; it cannot be received.
traceReason_lot_expiry_mismatch: The lot already exists with another expiry date.
traceReason_serial_unavailable: The serial is not in the branch stock to transfer.
traceReason_recall_query_invalid: Search by exactly one lot code or one serial.
inventoryCommandChecking: Checking the result… The server may or may not have recorded this command; the form is kept as it was.
inventoryLotListCapped: Only the first 100 lots are shown; type a lot code to narrow them.
inventoryCountRequired: Enter the counted quantity for every lot you counted.
inventoryRecallTruncated: There were too many results and some were cut; narrow the search.
returnConditionRequired: Choose the condition of the returned serial/lot goods.
returnLotTooMany: The quantity is more than the chosen lot can still take back.
returnForcedQuarantine: Lot {{code}} expired ({{expiry}}): the returned units go to quarantine and are not resold.
traceReason_opening_unreconciled_counts: The opening balance does not match: {{typed}} declared, {{core}} in stock.
traceReason_trace_serial_unit_mismatch: Serial goods sell only in a unit of one item per serial.
traceReason_trace_condition_required: Choose the condition of the returned serial/lot goods.
traceReason_trace_allocation_missing: A line has not held all its serials or lots; reserve the traced stock and try again.
traceReason_trace_fulfillment_mismatch: Held serials/lots do not match the quantity going out; reload the order and try again.
traceReason_trace_count_below_held: The count is below what open orders are holding.
traceReason_trace_serial_invalid: The serial code is not valid.
traceReason_trace_mode_mismatch: The item tracking does not match what was sent.
traceReason_enrollment_allocated: Placed orders still hold units at this location; finish them before declaring the opening balance.
traceReason_lot_quarantined: The lot is quarantined; it cannot be received into or transferred.
traceReason_count_stale: Stock changed after your count; reload and count again.
traceReason_duplicate_lot: Each lot may appear only once.
traceReason_duplicate_serial: A serial is both missing and found.
traceReason_self_approval: The requester cannot approve their own adjustment.
traceReason_not_pending: This adjustment is no longer pending.
traceReason_approval_required: This adjustment needs another person to approve it first.
featureOffTitle: This feature is not switched on for this branch
featureOff_credit: Credit sales are not switched on for this branch. Recorded debt can still be viewed and collected; ask a manager if needed.
featureOff_returns: Returns are not switched on for this branch. Returns already prepared still open from the order or the approvals page.
featureOff_refunds: New refund requests are not switched on for this branch. Existing requests can still be paid out, canceled or resolved.
featureOff_exchanges: Exchanges are not switched on for this branch. Exchange orders already opened can still be sold.
featureOff_traceability: Enrolling stock into serial/lot tracking (opening balances) is not switched on for this branch. Tracked stock can still be received, transferred, counted and looked up.
featureOff_customer_display: The customer display is not switched on for this branch: nothing new is connected or shown. A display already showing can still be opened, cleared and disconnected.
featureOff_cash_moves: Drawer cash in/out is not switched on for this branch. Requests already sent can still be confirmed or canceled; closing the shift is unaffected.
featureOff_exports: CSV export is not switched on for this branch. Files already exported stay downloadable until they expire.
featureDisabled: This feature was just switched off at the branch; the server recorded nothing. Work in progress can still be finished on its page.
featureDisabled_credit: Credit sales were just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded. Collect the full amount or leave the order waiting.
featureDisabled_returns: Returns were just switched off at the branch; no new return was recorded.
featureDisabled_refunds: New refunds were just switched off at the branch; this request was not recorded.
featureDisabled_exchanges: Exchanges were just switched off at the branch; no exchange order was opened.
featureDisabled_traceability: Enrolling stock into serial/lot tracking was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded.
featureDisabled_customer_display: The customer display was just switched off at the branch; no new order can be shown.
featureDisabled_cash_moves: Drawer cash in/out was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded.
featureDisabled_exports: CSV export was just switched off at the branch; no new file was made.
moduleOff: This branch has not turned on this module, so its setup is hidden. Goods already set up keep selling.
moduleDisabled: This branch has not turned on the module this needs; the server did not record it. Selling is not affected.

retail_units.label: Unit conversion
retail_units.description: Sell in sale units (packs, cases, blisters…) converted to the SKU's base unit.
retail_units.off: This branch has not turned on Unit conversion, so no new conversion can be set for a SKU. SKUs that already convert keep selling and can still go back to their base unit.
retail_units.disabled: This branch has not turned on Unit conversion; the server did not record the new conversion. Selling is not affected.

retail_measured.label: Weighed goods & scale labels
retail_measured.description: Sell by weight or volume and read EAN-13 labels printed by the scale.
retail_measured.off: This branch has not turned on Weighed goods & scale labels, so label formats cannot be added or changed and no new label code can be set. Labels already printed keep scanning and selling.
retail_measured.disabled: This branch has not turned on Weighed goods & scale labels; the server did not record this setup. Selling is not affected.

retail_traceability.label: Serials, lots & expiry
retail_traceability.description: Track each serial or lot with its expiry date, from receiving to sale and recall.
retail_traceability.off: This branch has not turned on Serials, lots & expiry, so no opening balance can be declared and no more SKUs can be tracked. Tracked stock still sells, receives, transfers, counts and traces.
retail_traceability.disabled: This branch has not turned on Serials, lots & expiry; the server did not record this setup. Selling tracked stock is not affected.

thoi_trang.label: Fashion

dien_tu_dien_may.label: Electronics & Appliances
dien_tu_dien_may.description: Phones, computers and appliances: each unit tracked by serial/IMEI, returns, exchanges and credit.

vat_lieu_xay_dung.label: Building materials
vat_lieu_xay_dung.description: Cement, bricks, steel: sell by bag, sheet, bar or truckload, on credit for regular customers and contractors.

nong_san_thuc_pham.label: Produce & Food
nong_san_thuc_pham.description: Vegetables, fruit, meat and fish: sell by weight, print scale labels and manage expiry by lot.

nha_thuoc.label: Pharmacy
nha_thuoc.description: Sell by pill, blister or box; lots and expiry dates managed, earliest expiry sold first.

xe_may_moc.label: Vehicles & Machinery
xe_may_moc.description: Motorbikes, bicycles, machines and parts: frame, engine or serial numbers tracked, and credit.

my_pham.label: Cosmetics
my_pham.description: Cosmetics and personal care: lots and expiry dates managed, exchanges under the store's policy.

noi_that_gia_dung.label: Furniture & Housewares
noi_that_gia_dung.description: Furniture and household goods: sell by set, card view of the catalog, credit for large orders.

me_be.label: Mother & Baby

sach_van_phong_pham.label: Books & Stationery

hoa_qua_tang.label: Flowers & Gifts
hoa_qua_tang.description: Fresh flowers, gift baskets and souvenirs: sell by bunch or basket and take VietQR transfers.

khac.label: Other
khac.description: An industry not in the list: unit conversion, weighed goods and serial/lot tracking come on; turn off what you don't need later.

cafe_tra_sua.label: Coffee & Milk tea
cafe_tra_sua.description: Menu, tickets to the drinks counter and order numbers to call customers.

karaoke_bida.label: Karaoke & Billiards
karaoke_bida.description: Rooms and tables billed by the hour, drinks, payment on the way out.

bar_pub_club.label: Bar, Pub & Club
bar_pub_club.description: Drinks menu, tickets to the bar, pay later and service charge.

cang_tin_tram_dung.label: Canteen & Rest stop

nha_hang.label: Restaurant

setup.title: Store setup
setup.intro: Choose your business, create the first branch and register. Nothing is sent to the server until the last step.
setup.doneOpening: The store is set up. Opening the sale screen…
setup.alreadyDone: This store is already set up
setup.alreadyDoneHint: Change a branch’s business or features under Settings → branch → Business model.
setup.askAdmin: Ask a store administrator to set up the POS.
setup.interestPrompt: The POS does not support {{name}} yet; we will let you know when it does. Do you also sell goods?
setup.interestDeclined: Your interest in {{name}} is noted. The POS can only create retail branches for now; if you sell goods, choose a retail business above.
setup.interestsRecorded: Businesses you are interested in (recorded when the store is created): {{names}}.
setup.wholesaleNote: Wholesale price lists come in a later update.
setup.branchCodeHint: Made from the name; you can edit it. Lowercase a-z, digits, hyphen or underscore; up to 32 characters.
setup.noLocationsTitle: The store has no stock location
setup.noLocationsHint: Every branch sells from a stock location. Create one in the Admin Dashboard under Settings → Stock locations, then press Reload stock locations.
setup.locationHint: Sales at the branch take stock from this location.
setup.registerHint: Leave blank if the branch sells without a register.
setup.grantSelf: Give me every permission at this branch
setup.grantSelfHint: Includes opening shifts, taking payments, approvals and branch settings. Untick if you will grant permissions to others later.
setup.modulesNone: This business turns on no extra feature; ordinary selling is enough.
setup.modulesLater: Turn each feature on or off later on the branch’s Business model page.
setup.viewList: The catalogue opens as a list.
setup.unitsHint: Units the store already has are kept as they are.
setup.featuresHint: Features with money or stock risk are off by default. Tick one only to turn it on now for the whole store; change them later under Branch features.
setup.summaryIntro: Check, then press Create the store.
setup.summaryGrantYes: Every permission at the new branch
setup.summaryGrantNo: No permission at the new branch
setup.problem_code: The branch code takes lowercase a-z, digits, hyphen or underscore, up to 32 characters.
setup.problem_no-locations: The store has no stock location; create one in the Admin Dashboard first.
setup.problem_return-window: Return window days is a whole number from 0 to 3650, or blank.
setup.problem_variance: The closing variance threshold is a VND amount, or blank.
setup.problem_adjustment: The stock adjustment threshold is a whole number, or blank.
setup.checking: Checking the result… The server may or may not have created the store; your answers are kept. Press Check again: the POS resends the same command, so no second branch is created.
setup.alreadyOnboarded: The store is already set up (perhaps from another device). No branch was added.
setup.createFailed: The store could not be created.

businessModel.title: Business model
businessModel.intro: A branch’s business suggests its features and defaults. Changing it never changes how configured goods sell.
businessModel.profileUnknown: The server did not send this branch’s business.
businessModel.changeIntro: Choose another business to preview the changes. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
businessModel.notInUse: Nothing at the branch is set up with this feature.
businessModel.usage_labelled_variants_one: {{count}} SKU with a scale label code
businessModel.usage_labelled_variants_other: {{count}} SKUs with a scale label code
businessModel.disableWarning: Selling configured SKUs does not change; only the setup screens are hidden. Tracked goods, weighed goods and converted units still sell, return and print as before; the server only refuses new setup.
businessModel.applyModules: Turn features on / off as the new business does
businessModel.applyModulesHint: Untick to keep the branch’s current features.
businessModel.diffModulesSame: The branch’s features do not change.
businessModel.applyDefaultFor: Use the new business’s value for {{name}}
businessModel.diffDefaultsSame: The branch defaults already match the new business.

businessModel.recommended: Usually used in this business (off now): {{list}}. Not turned on automatically; turn on under

businessModel.requiredBy: Needed by {{list}}; turn that off first.

businessModel.moduleConfirmOff: Turn off {{name}} at this branch: selling configured SKUs does not change; only the setup screens are hidden and new setup refused.
businessModel.storeIntro: The default business of new branches. Changing it does not change existing branches.
businessModel.storeSaved: The store’s main profile is saved.
businessModel.branchProfileHint: Defaults to the store’s main business. Changing it refills the defaults below.

businessModel.failure_profile_unavailable: This business is not supported for branches yet.
businessModel.failure_module_unavailable: This feature is not in this POS version yet.
businessModel.failure_reason_required: Enter a reason for the change.
businessModel.failure_onboarding_required: The store is not set up yet; finish Store setup first.

featureHint_credit: Requesting approval for and completing credit sales. Collections, debt lists and credit orders always stay open.
featureHint_returns: Preparing new returns. Prepared returns can still be received or canceled.
featureHint_refunds: New refund requests. Existing requests can still be paid out, canceled or resolved.
featureHint_exchanges: Opening an exchange order from a return.
featureHint_traceability: Enrolling stock into serial/lot tracking: opening balances and tracking mode changes. Tracked stock still receives, transfers and counts.
featureHint_customer_display: Connecting and showing orders on the customer display. Clear and disconnect always stay open.
featureHint_cash_moves: Cash in/out and safe drops during a shift. Confirming sent requests and closing the shift stay open.
featureHint_exports: Making new CSV files. Files already made stay downloadable.
branchFeaturesIntro: A risky feature runs at a branch only when the store has it on and the branch has not switched it off. A feature nobody switched on is off. Off only blocks new actions; money, documents and work in progress stay resolvable and are never deleted. Every change needs a reason and is audited.
branchFeaturesUnsupported: The server does not support per-branch feature switches yet; every feature follows staff permissions.
featureReadOnly: You can only view; administration rights are needed to switch features.
paymentNeedsOpenShift: This order's shift is not open or not yours: no payment, credit or completion can be recorded. Open your own shift at this register and start a new order; prepared tenders can still be checked or canceled.
refundNeedsOpenShift: The selected register has no open shift of yours. Cash refunds are booked on your open shift at this branch; without one the server refuses.
conflictReason_shift_closed: The order's shift is closed; the server records no more money on it.
draftReplayRefused: The earlier create-draft command belongs to a closed shift; the server made no new draft. A draft it did make is in the list below; open a new shift and press "New draft" if you need another.
featureBranchOnly: You can switch features off at this branch; switching one on for the store needs store administration rights.
featureConfirmStoreOn: Turn on {{name}} for every branch that has not switched it off. Only after testing and operational approval.
featureConfirmStoreOff: Turn off {{name}} at every branch: new actions are blocked at once, work in progress can still be finished.
featureConfirmBranchOff: Turn off {{name}} at this branch: new actions are blocked at once, work in progress can still be finished.
featureConfirmBranchRestore: Drop the branch switch: {{name}} at this branch follows the store setting.
featureSavedBranchRestore: {{name}} at this branch now follows the store setting.
collectionShiftHint: The selected register has no open shift of yours. The collection is booked on your open shift at this branch; without one the server refuses.
inventoryOpeningRecheckFor: Check the earlier opening balance of {{name}} again
paymentShowVietqrHint: Switches this transfer to VietQR: the QR carries the amount and note, and the bank reports the payment.
vietqrImageAlt: VietQR code to scan with a banking app
vietqrWaiting: Waiting for the bank… QR valid for {{time}}
vietqrExpired: The QR expired. Cancel and prepare again if the customer has not paid.
vietqrReceived: The bank reported the transfer. Finish the payment.
vietqrStatusUnknown: Cannot reach the server to check the transfer; retrying.
vietqrManual: The customer paid but no bank notification arrived
vietqrManualHint: Optional, for reconciliation only. Press Save to finish.
customerDisplayVietqrHint: Open your banking app and scan the code. Amount and transfer note are filled in for you.
conflictReason_vietqr_unavailable: VietQR is not available: the store has no active receiving account.
conflictReason_vietqr_provider_error: The payment provider did not create the QR. Try again or choose another method.
conflictReason_vietqr_evidence_required: Enter the bank transaction reference and receiving account.
conflictReason_vietqr_missing: The QR of this payment is gone. Cancel it and prepare a new one.
conflictReason_vietqr_not_received: The bank has not reported this transfer yet.
conflictReason_vietqr_confirm_failed: The VietQR payment could not be confirmed. Check the bank notifications in the dashboard.
conflictReason_vietqr_already_received: The bank already reported this transfer; finish the payment instead of canceling it.
conflictReason_vietqr_open: A VietQR transfer is already waiting for this sale.
featureOff_vietqr: VietQR is not switched on for this branch. QR codes already shown can still be confirmed or canceled.
featureDisabled_vietqr: VietQR was just switched off at the branch; no QR was created.
featureHint_vietqr: Shows a bank-transfer QR at the counter. Bank accounts are set up in the dashboard (Settings → VietQR).

loginShowcase.label: ParkViet POS features
loginShowcase.headline: Counter selling with control, from the cash drawer to every batch
loginShowcase.lead: One system for cashiers, managers and owners: run several orders side by side, take cash, bank transfer and VietQR, sell on credit with approval, trace batches and serials, and reconcile every shift.

slides.body: Every order is its own tab: customer A waits on a transfer while the cashier keeps serving customer B.
points: Search by name, SKU or barcode, or use a scanner
Scale labels read from EAN-13, sell in converted units
Same-code packs with different price, batch or expiry stay apart
Line and order discounts, Spree vouchers, manager approval codes

slides.title: Cash, bank transfer and VietQR on one order

loginShowcase.groupsTitle: Everything a multi-branch store needs at the counter
loginShowcase.groupsLead: Each feature group is built for real operations: clear permissions, a second approver where it matters, and no duplicate writes when the network drops.

groups.title: Selling
groups.summary: Fast at the counter, exact down to each pack.

items.title: Search and scan
items.body: Search by name, SKU or barcode in card or list view. Only goods assigned to the branch appear; ambiguous codes let the cashier choose.

items.title: Weighed goods and scale labels
items.body: Scan EAN-13 labels printed by a scale; the server reads the weight or price on the label.

items.title: Unit conversion
items.body: Sell by kg, litre, pack, case… converted to the SKU's base unit.

items.title: Serials and batches
items.body: Scan a serial per item; batches are picked by nearest expiry (FEFO), or chosen by the cashier where the branch allows it.

items.title: Separate packs per code
items.body: Two packs with the same code but a different price, batch or expiry are separate lines; a returned pack refunds its own price.

items.title: Customers
items.body: Walk-in by default; search by name, phone or email, or quick-create. A duplicate phone only warns, records are never merged automatically.

items.title: Discounts and price overrides
items.body: Line or order discounts (percent or VND with a reason) and Spree vouchers. Price overrides are a separate permission; going past limits needs a manager approval code.

items.title: Parallel orders
items.body: New draft, hold, reopen, discard draft and close tab; counter notes and pre-bill printing.

groups.title: Tenders
groups.summary: Three tenders, splittable, every đồng accounted for.

items.title: Cash
items.body: Enter the amount given and POS calculates change.

items.title: Bank transfer
items.body: The cashier confirms with the transaction reference and receiving account.

items.title: Self-reconciling VietQR
items.body: The QR code carries the amount and reference; SePay or PayOS webhooks report receipt right in the dialog. One pending VietQR code per order.

items.title: Split tenders
items.body: Enter an amount for each tender on the same order.

items.title: Wait and serve another order
items.body: Keep a tender pending confirmation, switch tabs and come back to continue.

items.title: Unallocated money
items.body: Overpayments and late transfers go to the received-funds ledger; authorised staff apply them to an order or hold them for a refund.

groups.title: Credit & collections
groups.summary: Let regulars buy on account while risk stays controlled.

items.title: Credit accounts
items.body: Limits, terms and suspension for each known customer; walk-in customers cannot buy on credit.

items.title: Approved credit
items.body: The cashier requests, a manager approves, then the order completes on credit. Each approval covers that order and amount only.

items.title: Customer receivables
items.body: Balances, overdue orders and debt age per customer.

items.title: Allocated collections
items.body: One collection spreads across orders, oldest first by default; collections never create new sales.

groups.title: Returns & exchanges
groups.summary: Right returns, right refunds, approval when needed.

items.title: Find the original order
items.body: Pick the returnable quantity and condition: resellable or damaged.

items.title: Preview the return
items.body: See the return value, debt reduction and refund before creating the slip.

items.title: Approval for risky returns
items.body: Other-branch returns, late returns and damaged goods need an approver.

items.title: Debt first, refund after
items.body: Return value reduces outstanding debt first; refunds count only once someone confirms the payout.

items.title: Exchanges
items.body: Open a new sale for the customer; the difference is collected or refunded as usual.

groups.title: Traceable inventory
groups.summary: Know where every batch and serial is, and who bought it.

items.title: Tracked items
items.body: Declare opening stock and reconcile before selling.

items.title: Batches
items.body: Expiry tracking, quarantine and release per batch.

items.title: Serial lookup
items.body: Status and history for every serial.

items.title: Receiving and transfers
items.body: Record receipts and moves between stock locations by batch and serial.

items.title: Counts and adjustments
items.body: Decreases, or increases over the limit, need an approver.

items.title: Recall
items.body: Find which orders and customers received a batch or serial.

groups.title: Shifts & cash book
groups.summary: Someone answers for every đồng in the drawer.

items.title: Open a shift
items.body: Enter the opening float; each shift belongs to one staff member at one register.

items.title: Cash in and out
items.body: Cash in posts immediately; cash out and safe drops need a document number and a confirmer.

items.title: Three-step close
items.body: Clear blockers, count the drawer, then reconcile.

items.title: Blind count
items.body: Expected cash and variance appear only after the count; over the branch limit needs a reason and an approver.

items.title: Close on behalf
items.body: Close an open shift for an absent cashier.

items.title: Late cash
items.body: Reconcile cash found after closing; closed shifts are never edited.

groups.title: Reports
groups.summary: The right branch, shift and viewer.

items.title: Five report tabs
items.body: Sales, Collections, Drawer cash, Receivables and Shift close.

items.title: Flexible filters
items.body: By date, register and shift, in the branch's time zone.

items.title: Viewing rights
items.body: Without the branch-wide report permission, staff see only their own shifts.

items.title: Background CSV export
items.body: Only the creator can download; files are deleted after 24 hours.

groups.title: Receipts, printing & customer display
groups.summary: Clear for customers, consistent on paper.

items.title: Find and print slips
items.body: Sale, return, refund and shift slips on 80mm roll or A4, with serials, batches and expiry.

items.title: Originals and copies
items.body: The first print is the original; later prints are stamped “COPY – no. N”. Receipts read “POS sales slip — not an e-invoice”.

items.title: Customer display
items.body: Its own window or device, no sign-in; shows the order, amount, receiving account and VietQR code.

items.title: Cashier in control
items.body: The cashier chooses what to show; switching tabs never changes the customer display.

items.title: Per-register scanner
items.body: Tune the terminator key and key interval per register; F2 jumps to product search.

groups.title: Administration & permissions
groups.summary: Configured per branch, granted per person.

items.title: Branches
items.body: Selling and receiving stock locations, time zone, return window, shift variance limit, batch picking at sale.

items.title: Registers and staff
items.body: Deactivation keeps history; reactivation needs the Recover permission.

items.title: 18 per-branch permissions
items.body: Open shifts, discounts, price overrides, approvals, returns, credit, inventory, report export… granted per staff member per branch.

items.title: Branch assortment
items.body: Each branch's own catalog, units and label codes per SKU, and scale label templates.

groups.title: Operational safety
groups.summary: No duplicates, no self-approval, nothing lost.

items.title: Second-person approval
items.body: Credit, refund payouts, drawer variances, cash out and stock adjustments; nobody approves their own request.

items.title: No duplicate writes offline
items.body: Writes lock while offline; once back online, POS replays the same action to check its outcome.

items.title: Order edit lock
items.body: Only one tab or device edits an order at a time; locks expire and can be taken over with permission.

items.title: Safe sign-out
items.body: With unresolved actions, POS asks before signing out; orders on the server are never deleted.

customerAddressHint: e.g. 1205 block S1.02, hang on the door
featureHint_quick_credit: For one-person shops. On together with “Credit sales”: the cashier puts the unpaid remainder on the customer's tab without a second person approving. A customer without a credit account gets one with a 2,000,000 ₫ limit, due in 30 days; going over the limit is still refused.
featureDisabled_quick_credit: Quick credit was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded. Collect the full amount or ask a manager to approve the credit.
quickCreditConfirm: Put {{amount}} on {{name}}'s tab and complete the order?
quickCreditHint: A customer without a credit account gets one with the default limit. Credit over the limit is refused.
receiptPayQrCaption: Scan to pay by bank transfer
payLaterShareNote: Note: {{note}} (keep it so the shop records your payment automatically)
payLaterShareHint: Send the customer the transfer QR (note {{note}}) via Zalo
payLaterCopied: Message copied; paste it into Zalo to send.
payLaterShareFailed: Could not share or copy the message.
featureHint_delivery: Mark orders to deliver to the door: type who delivers (no account needed) and an optional delivery fee. The fee is added to the order total. Sold orders wait under “To deliver” until marked delivered.
featureDisabled_delivery: Delivery was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded. The order can still be sold at the counter.
featureOff_delivery: Delivery is switched off at this branch. Orders already marked for delivery can still be marked delivered here.
deliveriesHint: Door-to-door orders of this branch. Tap “Delivered” once the customer has the goods.
deliveriesEmpty: Nothing is waiting to be delivered.
deliveriesReopened: Order {{number}} is waiting for delivery again.
deliveriesFailed: Could not update the delivery. Try again.
deliveriesNotPlaced: This order is not completed yet, so it cannot be delivered.
deliveryHint: This order is delivered to the door. A delivery fee, if any, is added to what the customer pays.
deliveryDelivererInvalid: The deliverer's name can be at most 80 characters.
deliveryFeeInvalid: The delivery fee must be a whole amount, for example 15000.
deliveryFeeLocked: Money was already taken, so the fee cannot change; the deliverer still can.
deliveryFeeInTotal: {{amount}} delivery fee is included in the order total.
deliveryFailed: Could not save the delivery details.
debtReminderRecordFailed: Sent, but the reminder time was not saved.
debtReminderNoQr: VietQR is off, so the message has no QR code.
debtReminderGreeting: Hi {{name}}, a gentle reminder from the shop:
debtReminderThanks: Please transfer when convenient. Thank you so much!
